title: Night Cream for Uneven Skin Tone: What Helps and What to Expect
ex: What makes skin tone look uneven, which night cream ingredients help, why sunscreen matters most, and an honest 8–12 week timeline.

rd: Night cream for uneven skin tone: common causes, ingredients like niacinamide and kojic acid, a simple night routine, sunscreen tips and a realistic timeline.
keyword: night cream for uneven skin tone
quick: Look for a night cream with niacinamide, kojic acid, alpha arbutin, vitamin C or glutathione, plus moisturising ingredients like aloe vera. Apply a thin layer over the whole face every night and wear sunscreen every morning. A more even-looking complexion usually takes 8–12 weeks.
facts: Sun, old marks and dryness are common causes of uneven-looking tone
One or two proven ingredients are enough
Daily sunscreen decides how well a night cream works
A more even look usually takes 8–12 weeks
